examples.text_en: The sea was turbulent after the storm.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨过后，大海波涛汹涌。

examples.text_en: They lived through a turbulent period of change.
examples.text_zh: 他们经历了一段动荡的变革时期。

examples.text_en: The children played on the soft green turf.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在柔软的绿色草皮上玩耍。

examples.text_en: He laid new turf in the garden last week.
examples.text_zh: 上周他在花园里铺了新草皮。

examples.text_en: His turgid speech bored the entire audience.
examples.text_zh: 他那浮夸的演讲让全场听众厌烦。

examples.text_en: The leaf was turgid and full of water.
examples.text_zh: 叶子因充满水分而胀得饱满。

examples.text_en: The office was in turmoil after the sudden news.
examples.text_zh: 突然的消息让办公室里一片混乱。

examples.text_en: Her mind was in turmoil before the big test.
examples.text_zh: 大考前她心里乱成一团。

examples.text_en: The turncoat left his friends for money.
examples.text_zh: 这个变节者为了钱离开了朋友。

examples.text_en: Everyone called him a turncoat after that.
examples.text_zh: 在那之后大家都叫他叛徒。

examples.text_en: He took a big turnip from the ground.
examples.text_zh: 他从地里拔出一个大芜菁。

examples.text_en: The turnip was fine food for the family.
examples.text_zh: 这个芜菁是这家人不错的食物。

examples.text_en: We drove along the turnpike for several hours.
examples.text_zh: 我们沿着高速公路开了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: The turnpike was busy with trucks this morning.
examples.text_zh: 今天早上高速公路上卡车很多。

examples.text_en: The judge condemned the moral turpitude of the act.
examples.text_zh: 法官谴责了这一行为的道德败坏。

examples.text_en: Such turpitude shocked the small quiet town.
examples.text_zh: 这种卑鄙行为震惊了这个安静的小镇。

examples.text_en: She wore a small turquoise in her hair.
examples.text_zh: 她的头发上戴着一小块绿松石。

examples.text_en: The sky was a clear turquoise that morning.
examples.text_zh: 那天早上天空是清澈的绿松石色。

examples.text_en: We climbed the narrow stairs to the turret.
examples.text_zh: 我们沿着狭窄的楼梯爬上了塔楼。

examples.text_en: A flag flew from the highest turret.
examples.text_zh: 一面旗子从最高的角楼上飘扬。

examples.text_en: The elephant broke a tusk on the rocks.
examples.text_zh: 那头大象在岩石上折断了一根长牙。

examples.text_en: Each tusk was long, white and heavy.
examples.text_zh: 每根长牙都又长、又白、又沉重。

examples.text_en: The two boys had a short tussle.
examples.text_zh: 两个男孩短暂地扭打了一场。

examples.text_en: There was a tussle over the last card.
examples.text_zh: 为了最后一张牌发生了争斗。

examples.text_en: She learned the craft under his careful tutelage.
examples.text_zh: 她在他悉心的指导下学会了这门手艺。

examples.text_en: The young boy studied under the tutelage of a master.
examples.text_zh: 这个男孩在一位大师的指导下学习。

examples.text_en: She read a short tutorial about the new code.
examples.text_zh: 她读了一篇关于新代码的简短指南。

examples.text_en: The tutorial helped him learn the system fast.
examples.text_zh: 这篇指南帮他很快学会了这个系统。

examples.text_en: He rented a tuxedo for the wedding.
examples.text_zh: 他为婚礼租了一套无尾礼服。

examples.text_en: She wore a black tuxedo to the party.
examples.text_zh: 她穿了一套黑色礼服去参加聚会。

examples.text_en: He talked twaddle all through the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 会议期间他一直在说废话。

examples.text_en: That is pure twaddle and no one believes it.
examples.text_zh: 那纯粹是废话，没人相信。

examples.text_en: They walked home in the soft twilight.
examples.text_zh: 他们在柔和的暮色中走回家。

examples.text_en: The twilight over the town was beautiful.
examples.text_zh: 小镇上空的暮色很美。

examples.text_en: She tied the box with a piece of twine.
examples.text_zh: 她用一段麻线把箱子捆好。

examples.text_en: The twine was strong and easy to cut.
examples.text_zh: 这麻线结实又容易剪断。

examples.text_en: He felt a twinge of pain in his back.
examples.text_zh: 他感到背部一阵刺痛。

examples.text_en: A twinge of doubt came over her mind.
examples.text_zh: 她心里涌起一阵疑虑。

examples.text_en: The oil tycoon bought a large estate.
examples.text_zh: 这位石油大亨买下了一座大庄园。

examples.text_en: A young tycoon runs the software company.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的大亨经营着这家软件公司。

examples.text_en: He typically works late and gets home late.
examples.text_zh: 他通常工作到很晚，回家也晚。

examples.text_en: The town is typically quiet in the morning.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇早上通常很安静。

examples.text_en: The report contained several typographical errors.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告里有几处印刷错误。

examples.text_en: A typographical mistake changed the meaning of the sentence.
examples.text_zh: 一个排版错误改变了这句话的意思。

examples.text_en: The tyrannical king was hated by everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这个残暴的国王被所有人憎恨。

examples.text_en: They fought against the tyrannical government.
examples.text_zh: 他们与暴虐的政府作斗争。

examples.text_en: The people fought the long tyranny.
examples.text_zh: 人民与长期的暴政作斗争。

examples.text_en: They lived under tyranny for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们在暴政下生活了许多年。

examples.text_en: As a tyro, he asked many simple questions.
examples.text_zh: 作为新手，他问了许多简单的问题。

examples.text_en: The tyro learned quickly from every mistake.
examples.text_zh: 这个生手从每个错误中学得很快。

examples.text_en: Mobile phones are ubiquitous in modern daily life.
examples.text_zh: 手机在现代日常生活中无处不在。

examples.text_en: Coffee shops seem ubiquitous in this busy city.
examples.text_zh: 在这个繁忙的城市里，咖啡馆似乎随处可见。

examples.text_en: The medical team found an ulcer in him.
examples.text_zh: 医疗团队在他体内发现了一处溃疡。

examples.text_en: He felt pain from the ulcer all night.
examples.text_zh: 他整夜都感到溃疡带来的疼痛。

examples.text_en: The wound may ulcerate if it stays dirty.
examples.text_zh: 如果伤口一直很脏，可能会溃烂。

examples.text_en: Poor care can ulcerate the surface of the skin.
examples.text_zh: 护理不当会使皮肤表面溃烂。

examples.text_en: He had an ulterior reason for his help.
examples.text_zh: 他帮忙是别有用心。

examples.text_en: No one knew her ulterior plans.
examples.text_zh: 没人知道她隐藏的计划。

examples.text_en: They gave the town an ultimatum that night.
examples.text_zh: 那晚他们向小镇发出了最后通牒。

examples.text_en: The ultimatum gave them only two days.
examples.text_zh: 这份最后通牒只给了他们两天时间。

examples.text_en: He wrote about an ultramundane form of life.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一种超世俗的生命形式。

examples.text_en: The book had an ultramundane and difficult style.
examples.text_zh: 这本书风格超俗而艰涩。

examples.text_en: The medical team used an ultrasonic tool.
examples.text_zh: 医疗团队使用了一件超声波工具。

examples.text_en: This ultrasonic form cannot be heard.
examples.text_zh: 这种超声波人耳听不到。

examples.text_en: He studied ultrasonics at the university.
examples.text_zh: 他在大学里研究超声学。

examples.text_en: The book about ultrasonics was very long.
examples.text_zh: 那本关于超声学的书很长。

examples.text_en: He took umbrage at her simple words.
examples.text_zh: 她一句简单的话让他动了怒。

examples.text_en: She took umbrage and left the room.
examples.text_zh: 她生气了，离开了房间。

examples.text_en: The room was plain and unadorned.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间朴素而没有装饰。

examples.text_en: He loved her simple and unadorned style.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢她朴素无华的风格。

examples.text_en: She stayed calm and unaffected by the criticism.
examples.text_zh: 她保持平静，不受批评影响。

examples.text_en: His simple, unaffected manner pleased everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他朴实自然的举止让每个人都很喜欢。

examples.text_en: He built the wall unaided in one day.
examples.text_zh: 他一天之内独自砌好了这面墙。

examples.text_en: She could not walk unaided after the fall.
examples.text_zh: 摔倒之后她无法独自走路。

examples.text_en: The members reached unanimity after a short debate.
examples.text_zh: 成员们经过简短讨论后达成了一致。

examples.text_en: There was complete unanimity among the judges.
examples.text_zh: 评委们之间意见完全一致。

examples.text_en: He was a quiet and unassuming man.
examples.text_zh: 他是个安静而谦逊的人。

examples.text_en: Her unassuming ways made everyone feel easy.
examples.text_zh: 她谦逊的作风让每个人都感到轻松。

examples.text_en: Such rude behavior is unbecoming for a teacher.
examples.text_zh: 这样粗鲁的行为对老师来说很不合适。

examples.text_en: The dress was unbecoming on her tall frame.
examples.text_zh: 这条裙子穿在她高高的身材上并不合适。

examples.text_en: The news was simply unbelievable to us all.
examples.text_zh: 这消息对我们所有人来说简直难以置信。

examples.text_en: His success was unbelievable and very fast.
examples.text_zh: 他的成功令人难以置信，而且来得很快。

examples.text_en: Try to unbend and enjoy the quiet evening.
examples.text_zh: 试着放松下来，享受这个安静的夜晚。

examples.text_en: He began to unbend after the busy week.
examples.text_zh: 忙碌的一周过后，他开始放松下来。

examples.text_en: We need an unbiased view of the facts.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要对事实有一个公正的看法。

examples.text_en: The report was fair and unbiased.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告公平而没有偏见。

examples.text_en: The words came unbidden to her mind.
examples.text_zh: 这些话不由自主地浮现在她脑海里。

examples.text_en: He came unbidden to the family meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他不请自来地参加了家庭聚会。

examples.text_en: Her record remained unblemished for many years.
examples.text_zh: 多年来她的记录一直清白无瑕。

examples.text_en: The apple had a smooth, unblemished skin.
examples.text_zh: 这个苹果表皮光滑，毫无瑕疵。

examples.text_en: There was an unbridgeable gap between them.
examples.text_zh: 他们之间有一道无法逾越的鸿沟。

examples.text_en: The two sides had an unbridgeable difference.
examples.text_zh: 双方存在无法弥合的分歧。

examples.text_en: He spoke with unbridled joy about the news.
examples.text_zh: 他兴高采烈地谈论这个消息。

examples.text_en: Their unbridled desire for money led them away.
examples.text_zh: 他们对金钱毫无节制的欲望让他们误入歧途。

examples.text_en: The team enjoyed an unbroken run of wins.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍取得了一连串不间断的胜利。

examples.text_en: A long, unbroken silence filled the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里笼罩着长久的沉默。

examples.text_en: There was an uncanny resemblance between the two.
examples.text_zh: 两人之间有一种离奇的相似。

examples.text_en: She has an uncanny ability to remember names.
examples.text_zh: 她有一种记住人名的奇特本领。

examples.text_en: There was great uncertainty about the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 关于这个新方案存在很大的不确定性。

examples.text_en: He could not live with such uncertainty.
examples.text_zh: 他无法忍受这样的不确定。

examples.text_en: They went into uncharted land that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年他们进入了未知的土地。

examples.text_en: The boat was lost in uncharted water.
examples.text_zh: 小船在未知的水域中失踪了。

examples.text_en: The reason for his sudden departure remains unclear.
examples.text_zh: 他突然离开的原因仍然不清楚。

examples.text_en: It is unclear what she meant by that remark.
examples.text_zh: 她说那句话是什么意思还不清楚。

examples.text_en: He stayed uncommitted during the long debate.
examples.text_zh: 在那场漫长的讨论中他一直保持中立。

examples.text_en: The budget still has uncommitted funds left.
examples.text_zh: 预算里还有未动用的资金。

examples.text_en: Her love for the child was unconditional.
examples.text_zh: 她对孩子的爱是无条件的。

examples.text_en: They gave him unconditional support that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天他们给予他无条件的支持。

examples.text_en: The price of the food was unconscionable.
examples.text_zh: 这食物的价格高得离谱。

examples.text_en: It was an unconscionable waste of money.
examples.text_zh: 这是对金钱极不合理的浪费。

examples.text_en: He had an unconventional way of doing things.
examples.text_zh: 他做事有不循常规的一套。

examples.text_en: Her style was unconventional but very fine.
examples.text_zh: 她的风格非常规，但很出色。

examples.text_en: His excuse sounded weak and unconvincing.
examples.text_zh: 他的借口听起来软弱，令人难以信服。

examples.text_en: The ending of the movie was rather unconvincing.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影的结尾相当不可信。

examples.text_en: His uncouth ways made the family feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他粗野的举止让家人很难受。

examples.text_en: The man was uncouth but had a good heart.
examples.text_zh: 这人虽然粗野，却有一颗好心。

examples.text_en: He gave an unctuous word to the chief.
examples.text_zh: 他对首领说了一句虚情假意的话。

examples.text_en: The food was unctuous and hard to eat.
examples.text_zh: 这食物油腻，难以下咽。

examples.text_en: She was undaunted by the many problems.
examples.text_zh: 她没有被诸多问题吓倒。

examples.text_en: The team worked on, undaunted by the loss.
examples.text_zh: 球队不顾失利，继续努力。

examples.text_en: They had to underbid the other company.
examples.text_zh: 他们不得不报出低于另一家公司的价格。

examples.text_en: He may underbid us to win the deal.
examples.text_zh: 他可能会出低价来赢下这笔交易。

examples.text_en: The chef sliced the undercut very thin.
examples.text_zh: 厨师把牛腰部的嫩肉切得很薄。

examples.text_en: This cut of undercut is tender and juicy.
examples.text_zh: 这块牛下侧肉又嫩又多汁。

examples.text_en: Strong facts undergird every good argument.
examples.text_zh: 有力的事实支撑着每一个好的论点。

examples.text_en: New laws will undergird the rights of workers.
examples.text_zh: 新的法律将保障工人的权利。

examples.text_en: She is an undergraduate at the university.
examples.text_zh: 她是这所大学的本科生。

examples.text_en: The undergraduate studied hard for the final test.
examples.text_zh: 这名本科生为期末考试努力学习。

examples.text_en: He used underhanded ways to win the game.
examples.text_zh: 他用了卑劣的手段赢得比赛。

examples.text_en: Such underhanded talk is not fair to anyone.
examples.text_zh: 这种背地里的言论对谁都不公平。

examples.text_en: Many facts underlie his simple decision.
examples.text_zh: 许多事实构成了他这一简单决定的基础。

examples.text_en: A deep fear may underlie his bad words.
examples.text_zh: 一种深深的恐惧也许是他恶言背后的根源。

examples.text_en: The manager blamed his underling for the error.
examples.text_zh: 经理把错误归咎于他的下属。

examples.text_en: Every underling feared the strict new boss.
examples.text_zh: 每个下属都害怕这位严厉的新上司。

examples.text_en: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
examples.text_zh: 不断的批评会削弱孩子的自信心。

examples.text_en: Poor sleep may undermine your health over time.
examples.text_zh: 睡眠不足久而久之会损害你的健康。

examples.text_en: He tried to underplay the great danger.
examples.text_zh: 他试图对巨大的危险轻描淡写。

examples.text_en: The report seemed to underplay the loss.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告似乎对损失轻描淡写。

examples.text_en: Please underscore the main point in your report.
examples.text_zh: 请在报告里给要点划上线。

examples.text_en: These facts underscore the need for change.
examples.text_zh: 这些事实凸显了变革的必要。

examples.text_en: Officials tend to understate the true cost.
examples.text_zh: 官员们往往轻描淡写地陈述真实成本。

examples.text_en: She tends to understate her own achievements.
examples.text_zh: 她往往对自己的成就轻描淡写。

examples.text_en: Her style was simple and understated.
examples.text_zh: 她的风格朴素而低调。

examples.text_en: He gave an understated answer to the question.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个问题给出了低调的回答。

examples.text_en: To say he was tired is an understatement.
examples.text_zh: 说他累了，这是一种保守的说法。

examples.text_en: Her words were a fine understatement of the facts.
examples.text_zh: 她的话是对事实的一种得体的轻描淡写。

examples.text_en: The understudy took the stage that night.
examples.text_zh: 那晚替角登上了舞台。

examples.text_en: She worked as an understudy for many years.
examples.text_zh: 她当了许多年的替角。

examples.text_en: The new factory remains badly underutilized.
examples.text_zh: 这家新工厂仍未得到充分利用。

examples.text_en: Many skilled workers are underutilized in this company.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司里许多熟练工人未得到充分利用。

examples.text_en: The bank agreed to underwrite the new loan.
examples.text_zh: 银行同意为这笔新贷款提供担保。

examples.text_en: Large firms often underwrite such public events.
examples.text_zh: 大公司常常为这类公共活动提供赞助。

examples.text_en: He felt the blame was undeserved.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得这责备是他不该受的。

examples.text_en: She gave him undeserved praise that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天她给了他不应得的赞扬。

examples.text_en: The drug may cause several undesirable side effects.
examples.text_zh: 这种药可能引起几种不良副作用。

examples.text_en: Such behavior is undesirable in a small team.
examples.text_zh: 在小的团队里，这种行为不受欢迎。

examples.text_en: The two forms were undifferentiated to him.
examples.text_zh: 在他看来这两种形式没有差别。

examples.text_en: They saw an undifferentiated group of people.
examples.text_zh: 他们看见一群没有区别的人。

examples.text_en: The letter was undirected and came back.
examples.text_zh: 这封信没有写地址，被退了回来。

examples.text_en: His early work was wild and undirected.
examples.text_zh: 他早期的作品狂放而无方向。

examples.text_en: The facts were clear and undisputable.
examples.text_zh: 这些事实清楚而无可争议。

examples.text_en: It is an undisputable truth about the world.
examples.text_zh: 这是关于这个世界无可争议的真理。

examples.text_en: The signal remained clear and undistorted.
examples.text_zh: 信号保持清晰，没有失真。

examples.text_en: We need an undistorted view of the facts.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要对事实有一种不失真的看法。

examples.text_en: The baby slept undisturbed through the night.
examples.text_zh: 婴儿整夜安睡，未受打扰。

examples.text_en: Please leave the papers undisturbed on the desk.
examples.text_zh: 请不要动桌上的文件。

examples.text_en: She gave the child her undivided attention.
examples.text_zh: 她把全部注意力都放在孩子身上。

examples.text_en: The group was undivided on the main question.
examples.text_zh: 团队在主要问题上意见一致。

examples.text_en: He put undue pressure on the young team.
examples.text_zh: 他对这支年轻队伍施加了过度的压力。

examples.text_en: There was undue worry about the small problem.
examples.text_zh: 对这个不大的问题有过度的担忧。

examples.text_en: The water seemed to undulate in the light.
examples.text_zh: 水面在光下似乎起伏波动。

examples.text_en: The land will undulate under the warm air.
examples.text_zh: 地面在暖空气中起伏波动。

examples.text_en: Workers managed to unearth an ancient coin.
examples.text_zh: 工人们设法挖出了一枚古币。

examples.text_en: Reporters hoped to unearth the hidden truth.
examples.text_zh: 记者们希望揭露隐藏的真相。

examples.text_en: There was an unearthly light over the town.
examples.text_zh: 小镇上空有一道奇异的光。

examples.text_en: She gave an unearthly cry in the night.
examples.text_zh: 她在夜里发出了一声怪异的叫喊。

examples.text_en: He called them unenlightened about the new way.
examples.text_zh: 他说他们对新方法愚昧无知。

examples.text_en: The unenlightened mind fears what it cannot see.
examples.text_zh: 未开化的心灵惧怕它看不见的东西。

examples.text_en: The road was long and very uneven.
examples.text_zh: 这条路又长又很不平坦。

examples.text_en: The two sides had an uneven match.
examples.text_zh: 双方进行了一场不均衡的较量。

examples.text_en: The paint was spread unevenly on the wall.
examples.text_zh: 油漆在墙上涂抹得不均匀。

examples.text_en: The team performed unevenly during the season.
examples.text_zh: 这支球队在整个赛季里表现不稳定。

examples.text_en: His record was unexceptionable and very clean.
examples.text_zh: 他的记录无懈可击，非常清白。

examples.text_en: She gave an unexceptionable answer to us all.
examples.text_zh: 她给了我们所有人一个无可指责的回答。

examples.text_en: The food was unexceptional and rather plain.
examples.text_zh: 这食物很平常，相当一般。

examples.text_en: It was an unexceptional day in the small town.
examples.text_zh: 这是小镇上平常的一天。

examples.text_en: She met every problem with unfailing patience.
examples.text_zh: 她以始终如一的耐心面对每个问题。

examples.text_en: His unfailing kindness won him many friends.
examples.text_zh: 他始终如一的善良为他赢得了许多朋友。

examples.text_en: Please unfasten your seat belt before standing up.
examples.text_zh: 起身前请解开安全带。

examples.text_en: She paused to unfasten the heavy wooden gate.
examples.text_zh: 她停下来解开那扇沉重的木门。

examples.text_en: The weather was unfavorable for a long hike.
examples.text_zh: 天气不适合长途徒步。

examples.text_en: The report gave an unfavorable view of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 报告对该计划持不利看法。

examples.text_en: Her joy was unfeigned and easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 她的喜悦是发自内心的，一眼就能看出。

examples.text_en: He showed unfeigned interest in our work.
examples.text_zh: 他对我们的工作表现出真诚的兴趣。

examples.text_en: The unfertilized land gave very little food.
examples.text_zh: 这块未施肥的地几乎产不出食物。

examples.text_en: They left the field unfertilized that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年他们让这块地闲置未施肥。

examples.text_en: The pilot stayed unflappable during the sudden storm.
examples.text_zh: 突然的风暴中，飞行员始终镇定自若。

examples.text_en: She is calm and unflappable under great pressure.
examples.text_zh: 在巨大压力下她冷静而镇定。

examples.text_en: The young dog was big and ungainly.
examples.text_zh: 这只小狗又大又笨拙。

examples.text_en: He made an ungainly move and fell down.
examples.text_zh: 他笨拙地一动，摔倒了。
